body.message:
On cheques, rent is paid monthly by bank transfer or card (3.1% fee applies to card). The security deposit is AED 2,000, fully refundable within 14 working days after check-out, and needs to be paid the same way, transfer or card, not cheque. No agency commission on top of that; the quoted rate plus deposit is all you pay.

Anything else you'd like to know before deciding on the 2BR?
